task_decomposition: Model 1 reviews the frozen evidence and allowed/forbidden claim boundaries, then classifies each claim C1-C6 as supported, unsupported, or forbidden with brief evidence references.
Model 2 receives Model 1 output, checks for overclaims or missed constraints, and revises classifications using only the frozen evidence.
Model 3 receives Model 2 output, focuses on ambiguity and wording risk, and proposes safer claim formulations where needed.
Model 4 receives Model 3 output, produces the final claim-boundary decision and confirms whether the inter-model process remained grounded in the local artifact evidence.
success_criteria: All six claims C1-C6 are classified consistently with the frozen evidence.
Forbidden claims are rejected without qualification as validated results.
Supported claims are tied to explicit run counts, variants, or Stage F/F scope from the evidence.
No production deployment, packet-capture benchmark, public-chain benchmark, full media-plane QoE, or 240-run six-variant ablation claim is introduced.
Final output demonstrates that each model used the previous model output to improve claim-boundary checking.
parsed.candidate_safe_claim: The artifact supports local workflow repeatability, executable baseline comparison, profile-labelled orchestration robustness, and model-assisted claim-boundary checking around local n8n evidence, including 156 frozen local artifact runs before the Stage E/F extension and 120 passed Stage D-real executions across three implemented variants.
candidate_risky_claims_to_check: The evidence proves production O-RAN deployment readiness.
The artifact includes a 240-run six-variant ablation study.
The results constitute a packet-capture network-impairment benchmark.
The evidence validates public-chain performance or full media-plane QoE.
parsed.next_agent_instruction: Receive this plan, classify C1-C6 against the frozen evidence, flag any unsupported or forbidden wording, and pass a revised evidence-grounded decision to the next model for further boundary checking.
